text: A potential tree-cover loss event of 13.5 hectares (3.9% of the property) was detected in 2025, but this requires further confirmation. No tree-cover loss was detected between 2021 and 2024. The 2025 event is still pending corroboration, meaning it hasn’t been confirmed by additional data. The cause of the potential loss (e.g., logging, fire, or natural disturbance) is unknown, and whether it was legal or illegal cannot be determined from this evidence alone. The property had 227.1 hectares of forest cover in 2020, so any loss would represent a small fraction of the total.
